blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States—The US State Department reacted with caution to the International Court of Justice’s ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority. The department said Washington was examining the decision while stressing the need to avoid “politicization” of the body. Washington’s wary response comes as the United States determined in 2022 that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya people. But it has more recently pushed back on another case before the top UN court, involving accusations by South Africa that US ally Israel perpetrated genocide in Gaza. “The proper interpretation of the Genocide Convention is of paramount importance, as is […]...
